entries.name: Stoa walnut & black workspace
entries.sofa: Walnut Decor · white linen · black workspace
entries.description: Selected 1.80 × 2.00 m bed shifted toward the glass. Woodendot Stoa Walnut Decor base (official 1.83 × 2.04 × 0.32 m), matching freestanding walnut nightstands, black height-adjustable desk on the left and black office chair facing that wall. Warm white bedding and restrained textured accents. The thin walnut headboard and art are additional styling proposals, not included with the linked bed base. Generated perspective is illustrative: exact clearances remain in the measured plans.

variants.label: 01 · Original placement
variants.note: Original image retained as an option at owner request. Bed placement reads more centred than the chosen measured layout.

variants.label: 02 · Closer to glass
variants.note: Additional option with bed shifted toward the glass and a visibly wider wardrobe-side aisle. Generated perspective remains approximate; measured plans govern exact fit.

variants.label: 03 · Toward bedroom entrance
variants.note: Reverse view of the closer-to-glass layout, using Bedroom wardrobes 1 and 2 for the original wardrobes and entrance alcove. Existing options remain available. Generated perspective; consult measured plans for exact fit.

entries.name: Stoa · simple bedding
entries.description: Same Stoa walnut bedroom and black workspace with simple bedding: exactly two sleeping pillows, one per sleeper, and one plain white Nordic duvet hanging loosely over the three free edges, untucked. No throw, decorative cushions or extra pillows. Three original viewpoints/placements preserved; closer-to-glass view selected by default. Earlier Stoa style remains unchanged.
